name: Pell Fen
seed: Welcome steward and records liaison. Translates rules; must question procedures that confuse newcomers. Home: East Deep.
design: Hedgehog with warm gray spines, cream waistcoat, blue satchel, large round desk stamp.
history: Worked in Latchford arrival houses before moving to East Deep five years ago. He knows how frightening a small confusing form can be.
desire: To make entering an unfamiliar place feel understandable.
contradiction: Uses procedure to postpone the discomfort of making a judgment.
relationships: Madger needs his practical questions; Bot helps with records; Pip knows his former workplace.
arc: Corrects a misleading rule publicly and takes responsibility for the people it delayed.
story_engine: An unsigned invitation is genuine; a perfect-looking document is irrelevant to the visitor’s actual need.
writer_truth: He once sent a family to the wrong queue and never learned their names; the memory drives his care.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
